items:
Casablanca -

Casablanca is a spectacular gulf front home with 3 living rooms, 7 bedrooms, and 8 bathrooms. A wonderful beach home to make your lasting vacation memories. Enjoy the spacious decks and beach front pool deck with BBQ grill! Casablanca encompasses two homes (main and guest) with a sprawling 7,288 square feet there is enough room for the whole family to spread out! This is as good as it gets!

Often referred to as “the town that began it all”, Santa Rosa Beach is the first established community in South Walton. Today, many of the communities that make up this majestic collection of beachfront developments are technically in Santa Rosa Beach. The most notable is Gulf Place – home to restaurants, bars, shops and galleries. Other attractions include Eden State Garden Park and the Santa Rosa Beach Golf Club. Guests seeking to spend their vacation in Santa Rosa Beach can opt for studio style condos at Gulf Place, large vacation homes with private pools near the beach or beachfront custom homes or townhomes.

Main House:

First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk and Twin Trundle + Tub/Shower Combo, Bonus Den with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Shared Soaking Tub, Laundry.

Second Floor: King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Walk-In Shower + Soaking Tub, Bedroom with Two King Beds and Walk-In Shower.

Third Floor: King Bedroom with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Tub/Shower Combo + Wet Bar and Balcony Access.

Guest House:

First Floor: Game Room with Pool Table, Foosball, and Bonus Den.

Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchenette, Dining, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk and Twin Trundle + Tub/Shower Combo.

*No weddings or events permitted.

*Note – This property may have date restrictions that apply. All reservations submitted online are a request until receiving an email confirmation from Ocean Reef Resorts. For more details, please review our Minimum Night Stay under Rental Policies. An e-signed rental agreement is required prior to arrival.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: We had four families staying here! 9 kids and 8 adults. We had plenty of space and it is very comfortable. The downstairs living room that is enclosed could easily be turned into a bedroom. The kitchen is wonderful and the main living room is great to gather in. The AC works great and the beds are wonderful. The house is a very short walk from the kayak and paddle board rental tent. Only downsides is that the condo right behind the house also shares the beach right in front of the house and the entry way is right next to the house. Also, the bedrooms have this weird window above the doors so light easily comes in from the hallway and light can easily come in from the windows. But I didn’t mind being woken up before 6am to enjoy the quiet beach! We couldn’t get the grill to work and the kitchen has no air vent so hamburger night was interesting. Overall I give the house a 9.5/10. It is beautiful, peaceful and the ocean view is a 10/10.
